title: Mythos Task Outcome
description: Canonical task-outcome artifact recording execution results and distinct-intelligence validation provenance. Bound to reports/analysis/task-outcomes/<task-id>.json.

task_id.description: Task identifier matching the source task-plan

divergences.description: Where execution diverged from the plan

should_harden_framework.description: Whether the outcome suggests the framework should be hardened

hardening_notes.description: Specific hardening recommendations based on outcome

completion_evidence.description: Durable evidence for all four completion criteria

all_steps_done.description: Whether all plan steps have been executed

operator_acceptance_received.description: Whether operator acceptance has been recorded

produced_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that produced this outcome

produced_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the producing actor

validated_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that validated this outcome for acceptance. Required for acceptance-grade completion when producer is intelligence.

validated_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the validating actor. Must differ from produced_by_harness_id for distinct-intelligence validation.

validation_artifact.description: Path to the durable validation artifact

validation_method.description: How validation was performed (e.g., codex-bridge, verify-local, operator-review)

distinct_intelligence_rule.description: When produced_by_actor_type is 'intelligence', acceptance-grade validation requires validated_by_actor_id != produced_by_actor_id AND validated_by_harness_id != produced_by_harness_id. Human review is supplemental only.
